timeline.election_day: Saturday 28 November, voting open 8 am to 6 pm
timeline.postal_votes_by_mail_admitted_until: 6 pm Friday 4 December (the Friday after election day)

stages: 2-candidate-preferred (2CP) count of the 2 candidates the Electoral Commissioner pre-selected
election_night: From 6 pm at election-day voting centres: primary and 2CP counts of ordinary votes
From 6 pm at election hubs: primary and 2CP counts of own-district early votes
From 6 pm at the central site: primary and 2CP counts of postal votes extracted on election day
later: Sunday: early own-district counts continue; other-district early votes and declaration votes go to the central site (vote exchange)
Monday onward: rechecks; postal votes keep arriving until 6 pm Friday 4 December
Primary count of all parcels can take more than a week
notes: The 2CP count is an indication only and has no effect on the official result; if the pre-selected pair looks wrong the VEC may remove that district's 2CP figures
New in 2026: 2CP uses rechecked figures; full distribution of preferences in every district, even where someone has a majority on first preferences; results by early voting centre published
Each region elects 5 members; quota = formal ballot papers / (5+1), plus 1
Some primary counts on election night, but all region ballot papers are counted at the central site; preferences data-entered twice
Primary count of all parcels can take over 10 days
Group voting tickets have been removed
